resources.string: This release includes improvements and bug fixes.

OneUI Aloha uses a new Android package name, so it will install as a separate app instead of replacing OneUI XP. App data will not transfer automatically. Keep OneUI XP installed until you have confirmed that OneUI Aloha works, then remove the old app if desired.
